sources.label: FNSPID — US semiconductors (2019–2020)
sources.description: Historical corpus from the FNSPID financial-news dataset, semiconductor slice covering the pre-Covid → Covid-shock → recovery arc. Static; does not update.

sources.label: FNSPID — qwen2.5 VM run (2019–2021)
sources.description: Full 2-year FNSPID semiconductor corpus extracted by the team's VM pipeline (qwen2.5:14b via Ollama on eib-central1a) and published through the VM→UI publisher. 5,358 articles / 30,861 triplets.

sources.label: Project report (PDF)
sources.description: The full three-semester project report — data, pipeline, GAT, benchmarks, live corpus, factor model, and UI — as an in-app PDF.

sources.label: STOXX Europe 600 (Live)
sources.description: Curated 30-ticker STOXX Europe 600 subset with enriched extraction (sentiment / materiality / event type per triplet). Daily factor rollup + PCA + KMeans clustering. Refreshed daily via GitHub Actions.
